03 / HOW I WORK我的方法

Different tools.工具在变，
The same curiosity.好奇心不变。

A project is more than its final screen. I care about understanding the problem, testing the choices and making the work understandable to someone else.项目不只是一张最终效果图。我关注问题本身，检验实现中的选择，也让别人能看懂过程与结果。

Learn & experiment学习与实验

Explore data, train models and examine where predictions fail.探索数据、训练模型，也关注预测为什么会失败。

OpenCV · NumPy
